headline: The funnel finally works: 5 booked in a week, 26 percent of replies. The machine feeding it ran at half power all week waiting on account 2.

sections.title: Binding constraint
sections.text: Volume, back in front of everything by causal order. 318 initials over 6 send days, 53 a day against the 105 plan, the worst volume week on record: an action block Monday, then four straight EOD notes reading main account only. Downstream the funnel performed: 6 replies, 5 bookings, first close signed. The lever is singular, get account 2 sending. Everything below volume is now measured as working.

Booked 5 vs 1: Josh, Matt, Evan, Ryan rosengren, rahul. Shown 1 (Matt, DQd bad fit, the screening doctrine working). Closed 1 (Daniel, zero setup fee by design, rev share is the deal). Cash EUR 0 vs EUR 0. All time deduplicated: 23 people replied, 6 booked (26.1 percent, closing on the 35 bar), 3 shown, 1 closed.

sections.title: Pace vs EUR 30,000

At the measured funnel (50 percent show, 1 of 3 closed, both under their sample gates) that is 1 to 2 closes. Whether they bring August cash depends entirely on pricing posture: a EUR 10k anchor deal pays this month, another zero fee rev share deal pays later. Honest band: EUR 0 to 10k.

sections.text: EOD anomalies all point one way: Monday's block plus main only Tuesday through Saturday equals the halved sends. Process this week: capacity doctrine moved to 105 across two accounts (v9), zero fee whale precedent recorded (Daniel), booking KPI fixed at 35 percent of replies (v8), Watchman caught every booking, cliff and hot reply live. Per account reply tagging is doctrine but untestable until account 2 sends.

sections.title: Binding constraint
sections.text: Booking, in causal order. Volume held at 69 percent of the 100 a day plan (412 initials over 6 send days, avg 69, block signs in the Aug 3 note), but the week's real break is above it: 11 positive replies came in and only MCP daniel got booked, a 9.1 percent week booking rate against the 35 percent baseline. Eleven open conversations carry no Status at all. The lever is working the queue to a tag: Booked, Talking, Waiting or Dead, nothing left blank.

sections.title: Notes and process
sections.text: Aug 3 note about account problems reads as an action block on the main account under the one account model; volume never broke 74 after it. Reply rate tripling with flat volume says the messaging or targeting improved, protect whatever changed. Process this week: booking KPI redefined as 35 percent of positive replies (Playbook v8), proof vault made doctrine (v6), Watchman live sweeps 4x daily, first call read scored (Kyle, 7 of 10), auto logging rails and Ask Palantir shipped awaiting env vars.

archive.headline: The constraint is the message, not the machine. Ladder at 6.2 follow ups per initial, comments at 96% coverage, logging 6 for 6, yet reply rate sits at 1.2% on 642 sends. Check the flagged IG account before touching copy.

sections.title: Binding constraint
sections.text: Execution went from suspect to clean this week, so the 1.2% all time reply rate (4 replies on 413 sends this week, about 1.0%) is now legitimately a first touch problem against a 3% floor. Before rewriting the opener, rule out deliverability: the Aug 3 EOD note says the first account has problems, and a throttled account produces exactly this signature. Account health check first, then rotate the opener.

sections.text: Initials 413 vs 229 (+80%). Follow ups 2,549 vs 818 (+212%). Comments 395 logged, about 96% of initials. sections.title: Pipeline
sections.text: Three Tier 1 replies are stale past 7 days unbooked: Owen the ai guy (10d), mrplusmoney (9d), cblez (9d). Adam and Matt are at 2 days. Ryan and rahul replied within the last day and are live conversations right now. Booking sits at 1 of 8 replies; two more replies and the tracker scores that rate officially.

sections.title: Lead sheet
sections.text: All 70 tracked leads show Date Last Sent of 31 July and every row is overdue (22 mid ladder due Aug 1, 48 evergreen due Aug 3), while the EOD form reports 400+ follow ups a day. Both cannot be fully true: either those sends go to leads the sheet does not track yet, or the sheet stopped being updated on day one. Settle which, or the queue data becomes decoration.

sections.title: Cash pace
sections.text: EUR 0 collected of the EUR 30,000 goal with 27 days left. Honest projection at current rates is roughly EUR 2,000 unless replies to booked moves. The month is winnable only through the two levers above: fix the reply rate and book the replies that already exist.
